purpose: Attack specificity of the already-sealed CKK CYCLE->WINDING motif on unseen physical cases. This is not a discovery benchmark; it asks whether the motif separates phase/topological 2pi closure from ordinary cyclic or geometrically winding dynamics.

primary_gate.note: PASS requires both enrichment and specificity. A control scoring 2/2 is a full-match false positive for this benchmark.

positive_targets.basis: single-valued wavefunction on angular coordinate gives integer azimuthal mode
optical phase accumulates 2pi times integer topological charge around phase singularity
condensate phase winds by 2pi times integer around vortex core
phi periodicity and single-valuedness imply integer magnetic quantum number
order-parameter angle winds by integer multiples of 2pi around vortex

negative_controls.adversarial: periodic but no integer topological phase winding
periodic but no integer topological phase winding
closed orbit winds geometrically around focus but has no topological quantization requirement
integer turn count exists classically without quantum/topological quantization

transfer_targets.role: anti-overclaim control: physical return requires 4pi, so CYCLE must not be equated numerically with universal 2pi return
